snippet.title: 12 Props Thor Actors Stole From Set
snippet.description:
Who doesn’t want to keep cool props from even cooler sets?? The Thor cast was full of thieves it seems, with most actors sneaking away from the set with possession or two… or seven. Any guesses which actor was guilty of swiping the most from the set?
Chris Hemsworth has played Thor in countless movies - including four where he was the title character, so it only makes sense that he has a lot of mementos from his time on set - let’s just say there may be a hammer in every room of his house. Christian Bale is new to the MCU, but that doesn’t mean he didn’t make sure he took home a little something. While Valkyrie actress Tessa Thompson hasn’t always lifted items from the set, she learned seeing her co-stars take plenty, that it was something she could probably get away with - especially since the actress is still slated for a few other projects in the MCU! We love to see it.
Chris Hemsworth isn’t the only one who made his way from the set with a hammer. Many other actors have taken the lighter versions of the hammers for safekeeping at home - but did anyone take one of the really heavy props with them??
Some actors did take their costumes from the set - but they had good and charitable reasons behind it. While these cases were considered “borrowing” we’re not so sure the Marvel team will see those outfits again! 
We can’t blame these actors for keeping these mementos from their time at work - we are curious though - how many hammers has the MCU made over the years!?

snippet.title: Doctor Strange Multiverse Of Madness BTS Featurette
snippet.description:
Wait a minute - did you think Disney would stop giving us more behind the scenes info for Doctor Strange in the Multiverse of Madness? Well let us be the first to show you what they were cooking up behind the scenes with a new in-depth look into all things madness!
Rolling out a film of this proportion - means you have to do things as real as possible. You need practical sets and effects - and the best CGI available. With the great Benedict Cumberbatch returning - and Elizabeth Olsen reprising her role - all you’d need is the right director. Considered to be one of the godfathers of the MCU - Sam Raimi takes on the helm - giving us a fresh take on that Marvel style. He pushed a lot of his own elements of horror - making it quite a terrifying ride for audiences. With those factors in place - Marvel could then focus on those precise details - costumes and character work. These things can really be overlooked in blockbuster films - so we’re very happy with the way it turned out in the end. With a surprising new look at the behind the scenes of Marvel’s Illuminati - you’ll be curious to know how filmmakers were able to pull off such an epic team up.
America we may need your help on this one - give us the portal we want behind the scenes and make sure we don’t end up in the cartoon world. We need all of you to help her focus her powers - on the best and most interesting ways this production team pulled off this sequel!

snippet.title: Behind The Making of Minions: The Rise of Gru
snippet.description:
Steve Carell is at the heart of Minions: The Rise of Gru. What? You think it's the minions? Naaaa. We're going behind the scenes to check out just went into making the movie. Carell's voice in the role is iconic, being an amalgamation of, or a general European accent of sorts (which doesn't exist but he somehow managed to invent one anyways). Did you know his children influenced the voice when they were just little? They're not so little anymore but his son is still so proud of his pop. But now that Carell is playing a young Gru, he's had to adjust the voice and make it even weirder than before. Is this movie feeling a bit like deja vu to you? If so, you're not going crazy, they've been marketing the Rise of Gru for over two years thanks to the pandemic. The longest any company has ever marketed a movie. After winning a lifetime achievement award Julie Andrews was reduced to recording in a closet. Taraji P. Henson was leaning into the softness of her character to really make her villainy stand out. You don't start at 100. Poor Danny Trejo wasn't allowed to be anything but himself. No acting allowed! The movie was jam-packed with improvisation too. Ready to find out more about your favourite little animated character? Once again, we aren't talking about the minions but Gru!!!

snippet.title: Doctor Strange Multiverse of Madness Deleted Scenes
snippet.description:
Doctor Strange in the Multiverse of Madness had over forty minutes of content cut from it! Pretty Mad, right? That’s why we’re going to check out all of the most interesting cut scenes we could find. Like the superheroes that just didn’t make the second draft like the quirky Phone Ranger, what happened with that original opening with Mordo, and even the silly Sam Raimi-style choice for an ending that related back to Michael Jackson’s Thriller. Wong was almost rewritten by Wanda to believe himself to be a Vegas Magician while Stephen Strange was almost Marvin Strange the powerless street musician. At least, one of the many Stranges would have been a powerless Magician. We can’t really see that making sense with the character in literally any universe. He’s got too much of an ego and a savior complex. Pizza Poppa, played by Bruce Campbell, got sprayed in the face with mustard for being a jerk. There’s one deleted scene of Doctor Stephen Strange and Doctor Palmer being chummy in an interview. We can’t help but wonder if this was filmed for the first movie. One huge leak turned out to be a giant troll when reshoots replaced it. Let’s just say the Minotaur was going to be more of an important figure. One version of Wasp would have been done away with in the most pathetic of ways. So pathetic it makes you feel bad. Yes, forty minutes of cuts could be an entire TV episode on its own. We should petition them to release it all! Until then, here’s hoping this video will suffice!

snippet.title: The Voices Behind DC League Of Super-Pets
snippet.description:
Just another superhero movie? Far from it. DC League of Super-Pets is unlike any other. And to make a one of a kind film - you need a one of a kind cast. Of course Dwayne “The Rock” Johnson is taking this one head on - teaming up with superstars including Kevin Hart and John Krasinski. The magic is just getting started with some great behind the mic moments of the cast!
So many voices so little time. They really hammered this one out quick - even with all the back and forth bickering between Hart and Johnson. Not a real brawl of course - but they seem to get at it as all best friends do from time to time. The cast as a whole really seemed to enjoy themselves in the booth - jumping around - and even dressing the part. When you hear them talk about their characters - you can see a twinkle of excitement in their eyes. Vanessa Bayer seemed a little too excited - dressing the part to get into the mood of her character! We wished everyone did that honestly - it looks like it really helps bring on that cartoon personality.
So if you love superheroes - and we’re sure you like pets. Why not give Super-Pets a try and get the best of both worlds? In the meantime - you can check out this video to see a lot of the time and work it takes to make an epic superdog movie with the Rock! Oh and Kevin Hart - can never forget the high energy.

snippet.title: 15 Grossest Things Stranger Things Actors Had To Do Behind The Scenes
snippet.description:
Stranger Things should seriously just be called Sticky Things because the whole series is filled with nasty gooey stuff like prosthetics, edible and inedible blood, lube, snots, and gas. Dacre Montgomery got the sticky prosthetics treatment and he had a blast playing with them at the end of the day when he was finally allowed to rip them off. Slimy, yet satisfying as Simba would say. Jamie Campbell Bower got all lubed up to slide into his Vecna costume. This is more common than you think. Your friendly neighborhood Spider-Man, played by Tom Holland also go the same treatment! Honestly, getting prosthetics on for six hours is bad enough but a whole sticky day inside of them just sounds like a good reason to say no to a role. Eleven’s first kiss with Mike led to many remarks from Millie about how disgusting the event would be. But what we think might’ve been more disgusting are the hundreds of Eggos or burgers she had to eat, or the vomiting that followed a ton of spinning. Her nosebleeds also led to a character choice that some people may find a bit creepy but it’s totally a practical thing! Poor Joe Keery had to do a fight scene while he was a sniffling mess. One of the boys was getting a little gassy on the bus. So gassy, in fact, it blew up. Just kidding. But it was nearly that bad.

snippet.title: Running Up That Hill Scene Behind The Scenes
snippet.description:
Max undoubtedly went through Hell when she got sucked into Vecna’s Mind Lair, but what exactly was it like for Sadie Sink to film this terrifying, iconic scene? In Stranger Things, the cast and crew do a great job of keeping us on the edge of our seats. There’s a ton of blood, sweat, and tears that go into giving us the verisimilitude we desire when watching a TV show, but would you believe how much glycerin and muddy, bloody water went into creating this scene alone? We’ve got a lot of thanks to give Sadie’s stunt double for taking some intense wipeouts and being mounted up onto a pillar after being dragged by a rope. We’ll also be talking in detail about what was real in that scene, and what was not even there. You’d be surprised at how much brilliant acting and reacting Sadie had to do when it came to imaginary obstacles and gore. Stranger Things 4 was filled with beautiful, emotional, and straight-up terrifying moments, so stick with us so we can take you behind the scenes of every step involved in the making one of the show’s most iconic scenes.

snippet.title: Bloopers From The Doctor Strange Multiverse of Madness Set
snippet.description:
As much as we love watching a clean and polished movie - there are few things we love more than seeing the bloopers behind them! Doctor Strange in the Madness of the Multiverse was chaotic on set, to say the least - and the energy these actors brought was equally wild!
Wandavision saw Elizabeth Olsen tackling some heavy and emotional material, so when she got to play the villain in Doctor Strange 2, she really let loose. Let’s just say, there were a whole lot of curse words coming from her mouth while filming! It seems that the madness of the multiverse got to her since she wound up doing some very unexpected and downright hilarious things between takes! Rachel McAdams found herself in all kinds of precarious positions - at one point, getting up close and personal with a crew member - but the actress always put her best foot forward. 
Benedict Cumberbatch has played the role of Doctor Strange multiple times, but even still, he struggles to get all those words out! While he didn’t always speak all his lines perfectly, he always brought a ton of energy. One particular hardship some of the actors faced was dealing with the giant fans on set - not fans of the movie…. Literal fans. The chaos they caused definitely struck a nerve with the actors who got leaves blown into their faces while trying to act cool!
It takes a lot to get a big film like this together, so it's great to see that they still manage to have fun and laughs behind the set - even if they ruin a few takes!

snippet.title: The Voices Behind Disney's Lightyear

Disney’s Lightyear movie included only the best of voices for their roster of character’s. Everyone from Chris Evans to James Brolin - had the resume credits to convince casting. Well - most of them. Chris Evans had some pretty big and confusing shoes to fill. Confusing in the respect that - he’s commemorating Tim Allen’s Buzz but - Evans is playing Allen’s Lightyear’s origin story. You know what? We’ll just halt the confusion there. Casting really wanted a lot of fan favorites in this one - of course they’d need Uzo Aduba to play the role of Alicia Hawthorne! All in all - they can put this one in the books as a success - and pretty cool experience if you ask us. But how did these actors approach their roles? snippet.title: Behind The Set Of Stranger Things Season 4
snippet.description:
Stranger Things has some of the coolest sets and season 4 certainly did not disappoint! From Rink-O-Mania to Skull Rock to the bottom of Love Lake, there’s plenty to explore.  Millie Bobby Brown and Noah Schnapp had a blast at the Rink-O-Mania, spending their breaks skating to Millie’s music. Love Lake required the use of a sixteen-foot-deep pool, and an old abandoned plot involving Joe Keery in a speedo! The winter Russian shots were actually done in Lithuania and froze David Harbour’s toes off. The Video Store was situated right next to a staple location from a previous season and both were originally used as the same place. Vecna’s layer is pretty freaking cool to see. The practical set is impressive but so is the CGI work! The Hawkins lab rainbow room was decked out with cushion pads to break the fall of the actors. There have been some brilliant homages to 80’s movies including E.T. We wish Surfer Boy Pizza was real. Good news! For a limited time, it is! The trailer park and the cemetery are being used to their full potential this season. Hawkins High School will look familiar to you, and we mean as more than just the high school you’ve already seen. It looks oddly familiar but we just can’t put our finger on it. The Creel House in its untouched form is far more beautiful than what they did with it for the show. It’s been a pretty intense season so far and we still have part 2 to look forward to!

Here it is - the end of a long era filled with dinosaurs and Chris Pratt. Jurassic World Dominion marked the end of the six film franchise - and the cast is just as emotional as we are. But with an end comes so really great reminiscing from the cast. We’re here to tell you some of the funniest - and challenging moments the cast and crew of Jurassic World struggled through.
Dominion marked an end - and with an end comes one legendary reunion. Film makers brought together Jeff Goldblum, Laura Dern, and Sam Neil to reprise their roles. This was almost too much to bear for die-hard Jurassic Park fans - and even more for the fans starring alongside them. They created some amazing moments behind the scenes - while Bryce Dallas Howard cackled her way through the emotional journey. But she wasn’t alone in her cackling - one costar in particular shares her infamous cackle. There was a lot in this movie that we never expected. Chris Pratt falling off a horse - was only the tip of the iceberg for on set stories to tell. And coming in second place for sure is the thought of more stories to tell. So is this all really the end of an era? Or is a certain someone telling the truth? We honestly can’t figure this guy out.
So if you’ve got a nice cozy place - away from the dinosaurs - sit down and marvel at some of the best on set stories the cast of Jurassic World has got to tell us.

snippet.title: Umbrella Academy Season 3 Behind The Scenes
snippet.description:
The Umbrella Academy is back - and this time it includes the Sparrows! Having seven siblings was a lot - so welcoming in a few new ones - and a cube of doom, well it made for a busy and chaotic set. Filming in a pandemic was something a lot of productions had to deal with, but a lot of productions don’t require a full fourteen characters on screen at a time. To say the Umbrella academy was a bit crowded is an understatement. The team filmed in plenty of locations, but they also spent a lot of time in a studio on built sets and filming stunts in front of green screens. 
To prepare for all those stunts - which many of the actors did themselves- the training regimen was intense. Actor Justin H. Min faced the most grueling conditioning work, getting shredded to portray a character he thought he knew. A very young cast member did some of the most daring stunts - which is surprising because another young actor was actually banned from being on set during certain scenes, meaning a body double took their place multiple times! 
The gorilla is back - but he’s lost some weight. Actor Tom Hopper didn’t escape his ape-man suit, but he did get an upgraded one featuring a much more svelte-looking primate physique! His feedback on how uncomfortable the suit was before was taken into consideration - a common practice on the Umbrella Academy set. All the actors get consulted during the writing process to keep everyone on the same page when the cameras start rolling! Thanks to this dream team, we got another stellar season of Umbrella Academy.

snippet.title: Stranger Things S4 Cast Getting Ready Behind The Scenes
snippet.description:
Stranger Things Season 4 is filled with prosthetics and fabulous 80’s makeup and costumes. So we thought it would be fun to take a peek at the process of getting into costume. Vecna was, of course, the most challenging prosthetic of not just the season but the entire show given it’s the first time they’ve really worked with prosthetics of this calibre, relying on CGI more in the past. Millie Bobby Brown takes an hour to get into costume thanks to her wig. Finn Wolfhard is tied for fastest to get into costume with the stand-out actor of the season, Sadie Sink. You couldn’t see anything but white through the white contacts so the wardrobe department thought it would be fun for the actors to try a little something to keep their nerves in check. Robert Englund knows everything about makeup and prosthetics after all his years playing Freddy Kreuger and other roles. He went straight from the makeup chair to another chair where he was bound to it. The poor guy couldn’t see, speak or use his hands. Did you know the origin story behind Gaten Matarazzo’s character, Dustin’s hats? David Harbour probably had the longest prep time. His prep started way before filming even began when he had to shed some weight to become malnourished Hopper. Dacre Montgomery had a fun time at the end of the day making a mess of his prosthetics. Joe Keery rolls onto set looking just a wee bit sleepy. Grace Van Dien willingly let her hair be cut for her role as Chrissy. Cara Buono and Joseph Quinn were rocking some awesome wigs. Yes, the looks this season were a pain to craft but all that work really pays off,

snippet.title: 15 Painful Scenes To Film In Harry Potter
snippet.description:
The Wizarding world isn’t always what it's cracked us to be! While there were days filled with magic and wonder, there were also some very painful situations that left actors in rough shape. From the lead actors to one of the film's directors - most people who were part of this crew suffered in one way or another.
Daniel Radcliffe faced his fair share of pain. His very first day on set left him in tears, struggling with an unfortunate accessory. Then in the later films, he dove headfirst into stunts that left him “bruised and battered.” While that seems like the most dangerous experience he would’ve had would be during daunting stunts, it was actually his co-stars that could cause some real suffering! Then there are the workplace hazards that come with spending multiple hours stuck underwater. Can anyone say infection??
Matthew Lewis became a valiant Neville in the later films, but it certainly didn’t stop him from getting one of the worst injuries on set thanks to co-star Helene Bonham Carter who got a bit carried away. Rupert Grint somehow wound up in a very dangerous situation in one of the earliest films - and he paid the price after he left the set bleeding! Tom Felton learned early on that he had to be careful around certain actors - including the person who would play his on-screen father. Unfortunately, accidents and mistakes were cause for a lot of bruises and cuts! After all that, it's no wonder he was caught on camera flinching before being hit in a scene - the fear was real! 
Despite the hardships, we doubt any of these actors would trade their Harry Potter experience for the world!

snippet.description:
Bloopers. Silly moments. Ridiculous antics. Weird observations. Dance parties. That’s what the cast of Stranger Things season 4 was all about. Millie Bobby Brown and Noah Schnapp got into the Fruit by the Foot challenge and the winner won by a long shot. See what we did there? Millie also crashed into Noah in a super cute-yet quirky incident that left them in an awkward pile on the floor. Last we checked this was rollerskating, not Twister! You may recall Finn being hit in the head with a suction-cuppy arrow. Well, it was a strange affair for him. Sadie Sink’s peaceful morning was so rudely interrupted by her costars destroying a chicken quesadilla. Noah’s favourite moment on set was actually his least favourite. One stunt person left them all hanging right at the end of the shot and they had to redo possible one of the trickiest shots in the whole season. ‘How’s that funny?’ you ask. Well, it’s all about what came next. Whether getting dressed up for jail or dressed down for waffles, Millie’s always considering her outfit. Sports were a big part of season 4. From learning to drive a golf ball to bowling without shoes on, going hard on the badminton course, or even just playing a good old-fashioned game of paper towel ball, we’ve come to understand sportsball is suuuuuper dangerous. We’re also going to take a bit of a rewind to our favourite moments from season 3. Ketchup and Mustard: The Musical was a big highlight. Hard to believe we only get one more season of antics after this.

snippet.title: Divergent Behind The Scenes
snippet.description:
Have you ever wondered what goes into making a complex film like Divergent? Well, wonder no more-- we’ve done all the research for you! We will be learning about the intense, Dauntless bootcamp the entire cast had to complete, the iconic seven-story jump – just how many takes did she do? We'll also be learning about the stunning visual effects that were meticulously crafted to maintain believabiltiy.
Part of what made Divergent such a fun film to shoot, was the natural chemistry between the cast. They had such much of it, in fact, that Theo James pulls a prank on Shailene Woodley during the big ferris wheel scene. How did they find Theo to play Four, anyway?
Did you know the author, Veronica Roth, was very involved  in making the film? So involved, she might’ve actually been in front of the camera a few times. If you missed her, don't worry, we’ll fill you in.
The Divergent world is full of incredible fight scenes, special effects, and elaborate set pieces you wouldn’t believe are actually set pieces– yes we’re talking about the pit! We’re also going to go into how much the city of Chicago shaped the visuals and special effects as well as the inevitable battle scars received by Zoe Kravitz and Shailene Woodley! And did we mention the incredible zipline that travels through all of downtown Chicago? After this video, you'll be an expert on how an action-packed film like Divergent is brought to life.
